characters.summary: The Grand Inquisitor is a formidable Pau'an dark side user, a former Jedi Temple Guard, and the leader of the Galactic Empire's Inquisitorius. He utilizes a spinning red double-bladed lightsaber for overwhelming offensive pressure and defense, combining agile acrobatics, Force telekinesis, and psychological warfare to hunt down surviving Jedi.

techniques: Dark side Force user and lightsaber duellist
Leads the Inquisitors, who hunt surviving Jedi and Force-sensitive children

weaknesses: Overconfidence in his own mastery and dark side philosophy
Stabbed by his own subordinate Reva, though he survived
